overview: The Committee on Public Health and Community Safety met to review and amend municipal ordinances targeting vegetation overgrowth and rodent control. Both measures were reported out of committee as amended to be forwarded to the City Council for a first reading.

items.title: Overgrowth Ordinance
items.summary: The committee approved and reported out of committee an ordinance authorizing the Board of Health to address excessive vegetation on private property, after amending it to redirect penalty fines to the general operating fund instead of a dedicated rodent control account.

items.title: Rodent Control Ordinance
items.summary: The committee approved and reported out of committee updated amendments to the rodent control ordinance, which establish regulations for composting, raise certain permitting fees, and scale fines depending on property size.

subject: Overgrowth and Rodent Control Ordinances
